plans.idea: Classic split: the bottle owns a left column while the right column reads top to bottom as logo, headline/copy, badge row, then a full-width CTA, all sharing one left edge.
Centered symmetric stack that keeps the original's story-style axis: logo, then the bottle, then a full-width headline block, then a bottom bar with the badges beside the CTA.
Z-pattern with a brand band on top (logo left, badges right), headline copy and CTA stacked on the left, and the bottle as a tall right-hand anchor.
